feat: add account settings features with configurable entry actions (#154)

Register eight personal-center app features (language, units, tutorials,
manual, help, rating, feedback, about) with STAC styles and Swan modules.
Shell targets may optionally set a feature entry action to trigger native
behavior without opening a page, configured from Robin shell studio.
